title: Labels of unequal worth and a team's capacity: the retail replica's rule-label trap caught, recall estimated from the random audit, and a certification that says what it lacks
request: Phase 8 (the owner's retail interview): noisy labels and review capacity as modifiers, a random audit sample, the retail replica as a kind's case, and the first certification of the modifiers on it and two real datasets.
plan: Pure statistics first: a queue of K a period, precision at K on confirmed labels, recall from rows reviewed at random within their stratum and period, the rule behind a noisy source.
Two modifiers with their detection, ledger points and recipe parts; the rare test reading the audit's rate under noisy labels.
The engine keeps a noisy source's rows out of training and judging and scores the holdout period's unconfirmed rows for the queue.
The retail replica as the rare-event kind's second case, and a certification harness on it, Telco and HyperAck.

decisions.decision: A noisy source's rows are left out of training and judging, not weighted.
decisions.why: Judging on confirmed labels only is the recipe's rule and needs no new path in the model fit; weights by agreement are left, said.

decisions.decision: The strata of the audit's estimate are the rule behind the noisy labels.
decisions.why: On the replica the team reviews the rule's hits and a random part of the rest: the rule is the old queue, so each reviewed row stands for its own stratum's rows of the day.

decisions.decision: The interval is the wider of a bootstrap over days and a Wilson interval on the weighted cases' effective count.
decisions.why: A short holdout with a few reviewed cases, all caught, gave every bootstrap draw 1.0.

decisions.decision: The retail case runs in the kinds check only.
decisions.why: Journeys, self-play and the team call a kind's accept: a second engine run there would slow them and change their checks.
The artifact check waits for 30.15 and no run is compared with a model on; the two real datasets show only the new modifiers' right absence.

change: dclab_core/capacity.py (0.88.0); dclab_core.modifiers noisy_labels and review_capacity with their facts; dclab_core.recipes CRITERIA, run_passes, certify; ledger points modifier.noisy_labels and modifier.review_capacity; the Solution's label_source_column, confirmed_sources, capacity_k and capacity_period; the proposal's label-source detection; the engine's label sources, the rule behind each with its agreement, and the capacity block; rare_event.retail_case and accept_retail; dclab_rnd/certify.py and evidence/campaigns/certification_v1.

findings.defect: The recall's interval read as certain.
findings.scenario: Seed 0 through the engine: 8 reviewed cases, all caught: recall 1.0, interval 1.0 to 1.0, while the true recall was 0.879.
findings.cause: Every bootstrap draw of days held only caught cases.
findings.fix: The interval widened by a Wilson interval on the weighted cases' effective count; covered on every seed.

findings.defect: HyperAck's forward split was not credited to time order.
findings.scenario: The proposal's first time column was created_date, the person's first_created_at.
findings.cause: The recipe kept time order only for the detected column.
findings.fix: Kept for any time column the solution names, the reason naming the chosen one.

findings.defect: A label source not applied became a feature.
findings.scenario: A table with ten confirmed labels: the noisy labels only ask and the audit did not flag the column.
findings.cause: Only an applied source was kept out; the earliest rows read held only the rule's labels, so the column was not even recognised.
findings.fix: A column of label-source words is recognised whichever appear, and forbidden unless applied as the source.

findings.defect: The label source reached the model on Home's path.
findings.scenario: Home's build and the wizard never sent label_source_column, and the proposal had taken the column out of its forbidden list.
findings.cause: The column was skipped from forbidden whenever it was a candidate.
findings.fix: Skipped only when the proposal applies it as the source; Home's build, the wizard and the API body carry the field.

findings.defect: A table with a label source could not be built through adopt.
findings.scenario: The proposal's plan forbade label_source while the proposal named it the source: the solution refused itself.
findings.cause: The plan's forbidden items were merged after the proposal's.
findings.fix: The applied source is taken out of the plan's forbidden items and out of the adopted list.

findings.defect: Rare positives applied but nothing acted on it.
findings.scenario: The proposal's metric read 24% positives including the rule's labels and proposed roc_auc; the engine read 5.8% on rule-chosen confirmed rows.
findings.cause: Both read a rate other than the one the rare test read.
findings.fix: Both read the audit's rate under noisy labels.

findings.defect: The split's reason named a column the run did not split on.
findings.scenario: HyperAck: the reason said created_date orders the rows; the run used first_created_at.
findings.fix: The reason names the chosen column and the detected one.

findings.defect: The certification judged parts true by construction.
findings.scenario: Detection true because the case declared the modifier; the model-off criterion true without a comparison; a real run counted where the part never applied.
findings.cause: Criteria read the run's applied parts and constants.
findings.fix: Detection judged on the proposal's reading, the model-off criterion pending, and only runs where a part applies counted toward its level.

findings.defect: The texts claimed parts not built.
findings.scenario: Weights, value times probability, precision at K as the selection metric, K stored from Home: none built; agreement promised but never computed.
findings.fix: Agreement computed per rule; the texts say what is left.

findings.defect: The queue's precision counted reviewed rows as if drawn at random within the queue.
findings.scenario: A rule-like queue: precision estimated 0.105 against a true 0.151.
findings.cause: The old rule and the audit chose which queued rows were reviewed.
findings.fix: Each reviewed row weighed by its period's and stratum's N/n, the raw counts beside it.

findings.defect: The operating threshold was read on the holdout.
findings.scenario: The K-th score recorded with the model came from the holdout period's scores.
findings.fix: Reported as the holdout's K-th score, a check; the operating threshold is set on training rows with the artifact.

findings.scenario: Sources that leave no confirmed rows; a counter as the time column; a kind's own machine credited with both modifiers.
findings.fix: Refused below twenty confirmed labels with the sources found; capacity only with dates; a machine never credited.

findings.scenario: The data catalog and the kinds' capability matrix.

measurements.name: the retail replica through the engine, seeds 0 to 2
measurements.gate: the Done when: the rule-label trap caught; recall estimated from the audit sample with its interval
measurements.result: every trap check passed on 3 seeds; recall from the audit 1.0 with intervals from 0.64 to 1.0, the true recall 0.88 to 1.0 inside on 3 of 3 seeds; the rule's agreement 0.17 to 0.18
measurements.against_gate: Both parts of the Done when hold on all 3 seeds.
limits: A short holdout: few reviewed cases, so wide intervals.

measurements.name: CRT-001, the first certification
measurements.gate: recipes.certify: a trap replica and 2 real datasets where the part applies, every criterion passed
measurements.result: 5 runs, 5 parts: no criterion failed; artifact and model-on pending on every run; every part experimental
limits: Telco and HyperAck show only the new modifiers' right absence.

outcome: The trap is caught and the audit's recall carries an honest interval; the modifiers stay experimental, and the certification names what each lacks.
lessons: A check that passes because the case stated the answer measures the case, not the system: judge detection on what was read before any statement.
Reviewed rows are a design, not a sample of the queue: weigh them by how they were drawn.
risks: Precision at K is the holdout queue's measure, not the selection metric inside training.
